items.title: Scrum's Meetings Are Capped at Five Hours a Week. Something Else Filled Your Calendar.
items.excerpt: Image Scrum has too many meetings. I have heard that sentence in training rooms since 2010 and for years I argued with it. Now I do the arithmetic on the whiteboard instead, because the Scrum Guide caps its own events and the cap is far below what anyone in the room guesses. Add up the limits as written. Sprint Planning is "timeboxed to a maximum of eight hours for a one-month Sprint," with four hours for the Sprint Review and three for the Retrospective.
